tools.name: classify_vehicle
tools.description: Classify a Brazilian light electric vehicle under Resolução Contran 996/2023 art. 2 and tell whether it needs a licence plate. Categories: bicicleta_eletrica, autopropelido (no plate), ciclomotor (plate + ACC or CNH A), motocicleta (plate + CNH A).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the measured catalogue of electric bikes, scooters, foldables, e-scooters and tricycles with specs (power, speed, battery, range, price) and legal status.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the catalogue by budget, power, range, load capacity or battery type. Returns best matches sorted by relevance.

tools.name: calculate_range
tools.description: Calculate usable battery energy (Wh) and realistic range in km from voltage and Ah, using the measured consumption baseline (24 Wh/km).

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare two to five catalogue models side by side: specs, legal category and price.
